name: proofbundle
description: Emit, verify and review proofbundle receipts from a Codex session, and verify the evidence a repository declares before a push, a pull request or a release. Verification proves authorship and integrity of what was recorded, not that any recorded value is true.

hooks.command: python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" --host codex || { echo 'proofbundle gate: the gate could not run, so the call is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }
